errors_at_half.title: At the default threshold Gemini Decision 1 and Clef are level (8 and 12 of 58 hijacks through, p = 0.39); Jev 1.14 lets 25 through

operating_points.title: With false blocks held to 5% over 3 passes, Gemini Decision 1 and Clef let no hijack through on the 32 report-half hijacks in every pass; Jev 1.14 lets 0 to 2 of 32 through

fooling.title: The units trick is the hardest attack: Jev 1.14 lets 8 of 8 through, Clef 7 and Gemini Decision 1 4

speed_cost.title: Jev 1.14 is both the fastest, 176 ms a decision, and the cheapest, $0.027 per 1,000 decisions

frontier.title: Gemini Decision 1 is 14 points more accurate than Jev 1.14 (p = 0.0001) at $46 against $27 per million decisions; Clef costs 2.4x Gemini for accuracy not distinguished from it (p = 0.39)
